error_categories.description: The trace answers a max-discrepancy question over four stores (Walmart, Target, Whole Foods, Albertsons) but only computes discrepancies for Whole Foods and Walmart. It omits Target and Albertsons entirely, so the claimed maximum is not established.

The key chart values (store cleanliness and value-for-dollar percentages) are presented as direct observations from unseen charts without any explicit tool-attributed textual source. In text-only mode, these media-grounded numeric readings are unsupported, so the downstream discrepancy calculation is not justified from the provided text alone.

summary: The trace reaches a clear conclusion, but it is not justified from text alone: the crucial chart percentages are unsupported visual claims, and the required comparison across all four stores is incomplete. Therefore the final answer cannot be verified in this text-only setting.
